verdict.rationale: Elicit documents a first-party API (with all API functionality also exposed through its MCP server) covering paper search, automated research reports, and an end-to-end Systematic Review with control over search, screening, extraction, and reporting. However, nothing shows parity with the much broader UI surface, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed support-site paths. Missing for 10: API coverage of Library management (collections, tags, edits, deletion), Research Agent sessions with skills, projects and collaboration, chat with papers, alerts/routines, and data export, plus a published API reference/spec and independent corroboration.
